newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SMM Finance Cayman sets US$150 mln secured FRN.
newsitem.headline: SMM Finance Cayman sets US$150 mln secured FRN.

text.p: The following issue was announced by the arrangers.
BORROWER SMM FINANCE CAYMAN LTD
(WHOLLY-OWNED BY THE WIDJAJA FAMILY)
GUARANTORS PT SUPRA VERITAS, PT SINAR MAS TUNGGAL AND PT
EXCOMM REMADJA
AMOUNT US$150 MLN COUPON 6ML+220-230BP*
TYPE SECURED FRN ISS PRICE PAR MATURITY 3 YRS
PUTS YR 2 AT PAR CALLS ** REPLIES 14.FEB.97
LISTING LUXEMBOURG REPAYMENT BULLET DENOMS $100K
SALE LMTS U.S. NOT 144A, OTHER LIMITS
NEG PLG -- CRS DEF YES**** FORCE MAJ --
HOME CTRY INDONESIA GOV LAW NEW YORK TAX PROV FREE
PAY DATE 04.MAR.97 (TENTATIVE)
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
LEAD MANAGERS US$10 MLN+ 90BP
CO-LEAD MANAGERS US$5 MLN+ 50BP
MANAGERS US$2 MLN+ 30BP
ARRANGERS & LEAD MANAGERS
AB CAPITAL MARKETS (HK) AND PEREGRINE FIXED INCOME.
NOTES *INDICATIVE COUPON RANGE. COUPON TO BE DETERMINED UPON
CLOSING OF GENERAL SYNDICATION.
**THE NOTES ARE CALLABLE ON EVERY INTEREST PAYMENT DATE
AT 102.6 FOR 1ST INTEREST PAYMENT DATE, AT 102.1 FOR
2ND INTEREST PAYMENT DATE, AT 101.6 FOR 3RD INTEREST
PAYMENT DATE, AT 101.1 FOR 4TH INTEREST PAYMENT DATE
AND AT 100.6 FOR 5TH INTEREST PAYMENT DATE.
****THE TERMS OF THE NOTES CONTAIN A CROSS DEFAULT
RELATING TO MULTIARTHA IN RESPECT OF INDEBTEDNESS FOR
BORROWED MONEY OF AT LEAST US$25,000,000.
SECURITY:(A) VOTING SHARES OF PT SINAR MAS MULTIARTHA
PLEDGED BY THE PLEDGORS, OR THE CASH
EQUIVALENT, EQUAL TO 210 PCT OF THE OUTSTANDING
PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF THE NOTES. (B) THE AGGREGATE
AMOUNT OF INTEREST DUE ON THE NOTES ON THE NEXT
PAYMENT DATE WILL BE DEPOSITED IN AN ESCROW ACCOUNT.
THE SECURITY WILL BE MARKED-TO-MARKET ON A MONTHLY
BASIS. REPLY DEADLINE FOR LEAD MANAGEMENT GROUP IS JAN
31. ROADSHOWS IN SEOUL ON JAN 22 AND IN SINGAPORE ON
JAN 23. SIGNING IS TENTATIVELY SET FOR FEB 25.
CLEARING THROUGH EUROCLEAR/CEDEL.
--Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
